description: This file defines the code-behind class for the Razor Page 'Index' in a web application. It manages the interaction between the page and the catalog view model service, fetching catalog items asynchronously, and updating the page model accordingly.

classes.name: IndexModel
classes.description: The page model class for the Index Razor Page, responsible for handling the page's data interactions.

methods.name: IndexModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the catalog view model service dependency.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to load the catalog items asynchronously based on the provided page ID and filters.
